title: EUS Procedures Using RIVOS™ EUS Access Device
official: Registry of Patients Undergoing Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) Procedures Using the RIVOS™ EUS Access Device
summary: This is a prospective study of patients undergoing EUS procedures using the RIVOS™ EUS access device.

interventions.name: EUS-guided intervention using the RIVOS™ EUS access device

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* All patients undergoing EUS-guided interventions using the RIVOS™ EUS access device

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years
* Patients who did not undergo EUS-guided interventions using the RIVOS™ EUS access device
